integrity: Analytical proof, exact-rational verification for canonical parameters, independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: For uniformly initialized two-half-branch quadratic random maps and all measurable state-dependent selection probabilities preserving Lebesgue probability, only lag-one coordinate covariance is optimized. No uniqueness of stationary probability or global ergodicity is claimed. Earlier symmetric stationary controls and IID switching observations are credited.
title: Sharp lag-one covariance freedom under a fixed invariant density
